desc: Derive the workload group boundaries: numbers in \([4^{k-1}, 4^k-1]\) require exactly \(k\) divisions.
Prove the minimum-operation formula: \(\max(M,\lceil S/2\rceil)\), where \(S\) is total workload and \(M\) is maximum individual workload.
Implement prefix workload computation and per-query aggregation in `Solution.minOperations`.
Execute and verify the supplied sample test cases.
